printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right.
row_scope: All explicit nonstop rows within the selected headings; connecting and through itineraries not transcribed or counted.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily, X excludes listed weekdays; 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not arrival-date rollover.

special_cases.SEA–DFW: 832 except Saturday; 874 Saturday only. Saturday 874 overlaps the end of the window and is included.
special_cases.Los Angeles/Ontario: Printed L suffix denotes LAX, O denotes ONT; separate airport records retained.
special_cases.exclusions: DFW–LAX 589 and LAX–DFW 500 begin 2 March; retained in raw audit only, with no active schedule or movement.
special_cases.stop_column: Only explicit stops=0 rows selected; DFW–SAN 487, SAN–DFW 423, LBB–DFW 1098 and TUL–DFW 1028 have stops and are not imported as nonstop.
